```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(leaflet)
library(tidyr)
library(htmlwidgets)
```

## Importação dos arquivos

```{r}
# a.
airports <- read_csv(
  "airports.csv",
  col_select = c(IATA_CODE, CITY, STATE, LATITUDE, LONGITUDE),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

airlines <- read_csv("airlines.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

processar_chunk <- function(chunk, pos) {
  chunk %>%
    select(DESTINATION_AIRPORT, ARRIVAL_DELAY) %>%
    filter(!str_starts(DESTINATION_AIRPORT, "1")) %>% # c.
    drop_na() %>%                                     # d.
    group_by(DESTINATION_AIRPORT) %>%                 
    summarise(                                        # e. 
      soma_atraso = sum(ARRIVAL_DELAY),
      n_voos = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

# b. 
estatisticas_acumuladas <- read_csv_chunked(
  file = "flights.csv",
  callback = DataFrameCallback$new(processar_chunk),
  chunk_size = 1000000,
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

# f.
flights <- estatisticas_acumuladas %>%
  group_by(DESTINATION_AIRPORT) %>%
  summarise(
    media_atraso = sum(soma_atraso) / sum(n_voos),
    total_voos = sum(n_voos),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

## Operação de "join"

a. A coluna que serve de chave na tabela flights é DESTINATION_AIRPORT.

b. A coluna que serve de chave na tabela airports é IATA_CODE.

```{r}
# c.
aeroportos_ausentes <- anti_join(
  flights, 
  airports, 
  by = c("DESTINATION_AIRPORT" = "IATA_CODE")
)
print(aeroportos_ausentes$DESTINATION_AIRPORT)

# d. & e.
flights <- left_join(
  flights, 
  airports, 
  by = c("DESTINATION_AIRPORT" = "IATA_CODE")
)
```

## Contagem de aeroportos por estado

```{r}
aeroportos_por_estado <- airports %>%
  drop_na(STATE) %>%
  count(STATE, name = "num_aeroportos", sort = TRUE)

print(aeroportos_por_estado, n = 60)
```

## Mapa de atrasos com leaflet

```{r}
#| eval: false
# a. & b. & c.
this <- leaflet(data = drop_na(flights, LATITUDE, LONGITUDE)) %>%
  addTiles() %>%
  addMarkers(
    lng = ~LONGITUDE,
    lat = ~LATITUDE,
    popup = ~paste0(
      "<b>Aeroporto:</b> ", DESTINATION_AIRPORT, "<br>",
      "<b>Cidade:</b> ", CITY, ", ", STATE, "<br>",
      "<b>Atraso Médio:</b> ", round(media_atraso, 2), " min"
    )
  )

# d. 
saveWidget(this, file = "mapa.html", selfcontained = TRUE)
this
```
